meta_title: Generator Tracker — run hours, fuel and maintenance for every generator
meta_description: Track generator run hours, fuel refills and service intervals. Offline-first, no ads, no tracking. Free on Google Play; coming soon to the App Store.
hero_eyebrow: Free on Google Play · App Store coming soon
hero_lead: Generator Tracker keeps run hours, fuel and service history for every generator you own — at home, on site or across a rental fleet. It works offline and syncs only if you want it to.
hero_note: No ads · No tracking · Open source
hero_shot_main_alt: Generator screen on Android with a running session
hero_shot_second_alt: Generator list on iPhone in dark mode
features_title: Everything a generator owner actually needs
features_lead: No spreadsheets, no paper logbook in the glovebox. One app for the numbers that matter.
f_session_d: Start a session when the generator starts and stop it when it stops. Elapsed time updates live; hours are calculated for you.
f_fuel_d: Log refills in seconds. The app works out litres per hour so you can plan fuel and spot a thirsty engine early.
f_service_d: Oil, filters, spark plugs — set intervals by engine hours, by days or both, and see what is due before it becomes a repair.
f_analytics_d: Hours and fuel by month, a comparison across generators and totals for the whole fleet.
f_fleet_d: From a single home backup unit to a rental fleet — each generator has its own history, stats and service plan.
f_sync_d: Sign in to keep a phone and a tablet in sync. Edits made offline are merged safely once you are back online.
show1_title: Start when it starts. Stop when it stops.
show1_text: A big START SESSION button and a live timer — easy to hit in the dark during an outage or with gloves on a job site. Forgot to tap? Add or fix a session later with exact times.
show1_alt: Generator detail screen with a running session
show2_title: Service on time, not after a breakdown.
show2_text: Each task tracks engine hours and calendar days since the last service. Due soon and due now are flagged on the home screen, and one tap marks a task as serviced.
show2_alt: Maintenance tasks with OK, due soon and due statuses
show3_title: See where the hours and the fuel go.
show3_text: Monthly charts for run hours and fuel, a comparison between generators and averages per unit — filter by one generator or look at all of them.
show3_alt: Analytics charts with fuel consumption by month
platforms_lead: Not a web page in a wrapper. Material 3 on Android, the native iOS design — including Liquid Glass — on iPhone and iPad.
pl_android_d: Material 3 navigation, system dialogs and dark theme. Phones, tablets and foldables.
pl_ios_d: Native navigation bars, SwiftUI forms, SF Symbols and Liquid Glass on iOS 26.
pl_ios_status: Coming soon to the App Store
privacy_lead: Generator Tracker stores everything on your device first. An account is optional and used only to sync your own records between your devices.
pv_local_d: Every record is saved on the device; the app is fully usable without an account or a connection.
pv_track_d: No analytics SDKs, no advertising IDs, no profiling. Nothing is sold or shared.
pv_open_d: The full source code is on GitHub under the MIT license — anyone can check what the app does.
a1: Yes. The app is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.
q2: Does it work without the internet?
a2: Yes. Everything is stored on your device and works offline. If you sign in, changes sync automatically when a connection is available.
a3: Android phones, tablets and foldables (Android 7.0 and newer) today. iPhone and iPad are coming to the App Store soon.
q4: Can I use it for several generators?
a4: Yes — add as many as you need. Each one keeps its own sessions, refills, service plan and statistics.
q5: How do I delete my data?
a5: Data stored only on your phone is removed when you delete it in the app or uninstall the app. To delete a synced account and its cloud data, email yuri.valigursky@gmail.com — see the privacy policy for details.
a6: English and Ukrainian. The app follows your device language and can be switched in Settings.
cta_title: Put your generator on the record.
cta_text: Free, offline-first and private. Installs in a minute.
